title: GovBills — From receipt to settlement
description: Ministry-controlled invoice operations: staff see their responsible work, reconcile evidence and move provider-specific batches through independent approval and payment controls. Demo records only; no live bank transfers.

title: From invoice receipt to confirmed settlement
description: Eight-step conceptual journey: receipt, checks and registration, provider reconciliation, batch preparation, batch approval, grouping and independent authorisation, settlement, bank matching and audit. Reconciliation remains mandatory before approval and settlement.

title: MySpace personal home and admin governance
description: Conceptual MySpace schematic. Saved folder views with unit and provider filters; own and role-responsible batches and invoices; My Work tasks, plans, anomalies and overdues. Admin set/reset passwords with re-authentication, ministry boundaries, session invalidation and forced change after temporary reset.

title: Folder and ZIP intake with account allocation
description: Upload a folder or ZIP; preserve sources and route missing accounts to unit administrators. Admin maps dedicated-mailbox authorised senders to providers. Automatic staging requires a trusted relay, sender-authentication evidence and clean attachment scans; Outlook is not connected.

title: Map the provider layout once, then check every invoice
description: Map each provider's invoice layout once; reuse it for later imports. Check extracted invoice values against the source. Flag receipt-date anomalies and due-date urgency. Show surcharges alongside invoice totals

title: Provider XLS/CSV reconciliation and the Unsorted basket
description: Import the provider's pending-invoice XLS or CSV. Match account, invoice reference and amount. Mismatches go to the Unsorted basket for resolution. Reconciliation comes before approval and settlement

title: Single-provider batch preparation
description: Each batch holds invoices for one provider only. Preparation, Work in Progress and Rejected folders. Inspect invoices, amounts and lifecycle history. Ministry access boundaries apply throughout

title: Batch-only approvals, process map and stamped copy
description: Approvals act on the whole batch, never single invoices. Process map shows the current stage and owner. Approval produces a stamped copy kept as evidence. Overdue approval tasks surface in My Work

title: Grouping approved batches of the same provider
description: Finance groups approved batches for one provider. Mixed-provider grouping is not allowed. Validate approval and reconciliation evidence first. Batch amounts and history stay traceable. Demo settlement records; no live transfer.

title: Independent authorisation and bank reference
description: A separate authoriser approves the settlement. Preparer and authoriser remain distinct people. Bank reference recorded against the settlement. Execution history retained for audit. Demo references only; no real bank details are shown.

title: Post-settlement bank match
description: Import the bank statement after settlement. Match statement lines to settlement references. Unmatched lines stay open with an owner. Matched results close the loop for audit

title: Disputes, waivers and refunds with preserved evidence
description: Open a dispute case against a provider invoice. Record waivers and refunds as tracked outcomes. Historical evidence is preserved, never overwritten. Case history links back to batch and invoice

title: Operational visibility and drill-through
description: Assigned tasks, plans, anomalies and overdues in one place. Key work areas open on an Overview dashboard. All providers by default; explicit filters kept in drills. Operating overview and historical insights kept distinct. Utility providers and Organisation open on Overview with register tabs; legacy URLs kept

title: Operational wins and rollout readiness
description: Qualitative wins: less searching, reduced re-keying, clear handoffs, compact overdue alerts, ministry lateness/surcharge drill-through and preserved audit evidence. Readiness: trusted mail relay and notification gateways, MFA hardening and demo-only captures. No quantified savings or live bank execution claimed.
